diagram_previews.alt: Trapezoid ABCD with AB on top and CD at the bottom, E the midpoint of CD. The diagonals AC and DB meet at G. The blue segment AE meets DB at F with a right-angle mark; a dashed grey segment joins B to E, and a right-angle mark at B shows that angle DBC is 90 degrees.
